pokedexEntries.ru: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.

pokedexEntries.sa: LUVDISC’s heart-shaped body is a symbol of love and romance. It is said that any couple meeting this POKéMON is promised a loving relationship that never ends.

pokedexEntries.frlg: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

pokedexEntries.em: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one’s feelings of love.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a LUVDISC to someone you love.
